name: @dgtalbug/deck

scripts.test:fast: bun test tests/board tests/cli tests/core tests/evaluation tests/graph tests/performance tests/server tests/ui tests/ci-workflow.test.ts
scripts.test:smoke: bun run build:bin && bun test tests/smoke/
scripts.build:ui: rm -rf dist/ui && bun build src/ui/app.tsx --outdir dist/ui --minify --splitting && bun run scripts/check-ui-budget.ts && bun run scripts/embed-ui.ts
scripts.build:bin: bun run build:ui && bun run scripts/embed-migrations.ts && bun build --compile --define DECK_FEATURE_GROOMING:true --define DECK_FEATURE_SSE:true --define DECK_FEATURE_TWEAK:true src/cli/main.ts --outfile deck

description: The SDD engine board: deck-born spec-driven development with verbs, verify convergence, hooks, and memory — one sqlite board, GitHub publication, zero ceremony.
